review.why: Choose and build Stripe integrations correctly: Checkout, webhooks, billing, tax, Connect and API key security, with the traps to avoid.
review.summary: Stripe's own routing skill: a table that maps what you are building to the right API, critical rules (always use webhooks, never pass payment_method_types, use a StripeClient, prefer restricted keys, check tax registrations), and reference files for payments, billing, Connect, tax, Treasury and security.
strengths: Decision table from goal to API, and critical rules that prevent the most common integration mistakes.
The payments reference explains why fulfillment belongs in webhook handlers and lists deprecated APIs with their replacements.
The security reference covers secret storage per platform, restricted keys, key rotation, webhook signatures, CSP and Connect liability.
cautions: The repository holds six identical copies of this skill (one per agent provider), so the name alone is not unique and a name-based install command is not offered.
SKILL.md and the payments and security references were read in full; the billing, Connect, tax and Treasury references (about 50 KB) were not read line by line.
Version numbers and API dates in the text are those of the pinned commit and will age; it also assumes access to Stripe's documentation and optionally its MCP server.
